acts/11/1: 11 Ana nan, sai manzannin da ꞌyanꞌuwa da ke Yahudiya sun ji cewa mutanen alꞌummai ma sun karɓi kalmar Allah.
acts/11/2: Da Bitrus ya shiga Urushalima, sai waɗanda suke goyon bayan yin kaciya suka soma gardama da shi,
acts/11/3: suna cewa: “Ka shiga cikin gidan mutanen da ba a yi musu kaciya ba, kuma ka ci abinci tare da su.”
acts/11/4: Da jin hakan, sai Bitrus ya soma bayyana musu batun dalla-dalla, yana cewa:
acts/11/5: “Saꞌad da nake birnin Joffa ina adduꞌa, sai na ga wahayi. A cikin wahayin na ga wani abu kamar babban yadin lilin da ake saukar da shi ta gefe huɗu na yadin daga sama, kuma ya sauko daidai inda nake.
acts/11/6: Da na duba da kyau, sai na ga dabbobi masu ƙafafu huɗu, da dabbobin daji, da dabbobi masu rarrafe, da kuma tsuntsayen sama.
acts/11/7: Na kuma ji wata murya ta ce mini: ‘Ka tashi Bitrus, ka yanka ka ci!’
acts/11/8: Amma na ce: ‘Aꞌa, ya Ubangiji, domin abu mai ƙazanta kuma marar tsabta bai taɓa shiga bakina ba.’
acts/11/9: A karo na biyu, muryar daga sama ta amsa mini cewa: ‘Ka daina kiran abin da Allah ya tsabtace, abu mai ƙazanta.’
acts/11/10: Hakan ya faru har sau uku, sai aka ɗauke kome zuwa sama.
acts/11/11: Ƙari ga haka, a daidai wannan lokacin, mutane uku suna tsaye a gidan da muke zama, an aiko su wurina daga Kaisariya.
acts/11/12: Sai ruhun ya ce mini in bi su, kada in yi shakka ko kaɗan. Waɗannan ꞌyanꞌuwa shida ma sun bi ni, kuma tare muka shiga gidan mutumin.
acts/11/13: “Ya ba mu labarin yadda ya ga wani malaꞌika yana tsaye a gidansa kuma ya ce masa: ‘Ka aika mutane zuwa Joffa su kira Siman, wanda ake kira Bitrus,
acts/11/14: kuma zai gaya maka abin da zai sa kai da dukan mutanen gidanka ku sami ceto.’
acts/11/15: Da na soma magana, sai ruhu mai tsarki ya sauko a kansu kamar yadda ya sauko a kanmu da farko.
acts/11/16: Da jin haka, sai na tuna abin da Ubangiji ya sha faɗa cewa: ‘Yohanna ya yi baftisma da ruwa, amma za a yi muku baftisma da ruhu mai tsarki.’
acts/11/17: Don haka, idan Allah ya ba su irin kyautar da ya ba mu, mu da muka ba da gaskiya ga Ubangiji Yesu Kristi, to wane ne ni da zan hana Allah?”
acts/11/18: Da suka ji abubuwan nan, sai suka daina gardama da shi, kuma sun ɗaukaka Allah, suna cewa: “Ashe, Allah ya buɗe hanya ga mutanen alꞌummai su iya tuba kuma su sami rai.”
acts/11/19: Waɗanda suka watse saboda tsanantawa da ta taso saboda Istifanus, sun gudu zuwa wurare kamar Finikiya, da Saifrus, da kuma Antakiya. Amma sun yi waꞌazin kalmar Allah ga Yahudawa ne kaɗai.
acts/11/20: Sai wasu mutane daga cikinsu, daga Saifrus da Sayirin sun zo Antakiya kuma sun soma magana da mutanen da ke yaren Girka, suna yi musu shelar labari mai daɗi na Ubangiji Yesu.
acts/11/21: Ƙari ga haka, Jehobah yana tare da su, kuma mutane masu yawa sosai sun ba da gaskiya kuma suka juyo wurin Ubangiji.
acts/11/22: Labarinsu ya isa ikilisiyar da ke Urushalima, sai ikilisiyar ta aiki Barnabas zuwa can Antakiya.
acts/11/23: Saꞌad da ya isa wurin kuma ya ga yadda Allah ya nuna musu alherinsa, ya yi murna kuma ya soma ƙarfafa dukansu su ci-gaba da bin Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarsu;
acts/11/24: domin Barnabas mutumin kirki ne kuma yana cike da ruhu mai tsarki da bangaskiya. Kuma an sami ƙarin mutane masu yawa da suka soma bin Ubangiji.
acts/11/25: Sai ya tafi Tarsus domin ya nemi Shawulu da kyau.
acts/11/26: Da ya same shi, sai ya kawo shi Antakiya. Don haka, sun yi shekara ɗaya suna taruwa da ikilisiyar da ke Antakiya kuma sun koyar da mutane da yawa. A Antakiya ne aka soma kiran almajiran Yesu Kristoci, bisa ga umurnin da Allah ya bayar.
acts/11/27: A kwanakin, annabawa suka zo Antakiya daga Urushalima.
acts/11/28: Ɗaya daga cikinsu mai suna Agabus ya tashi kuma ya yi annabci ta wurin ruhu mai tsarki cewa an kusan soma yunwa mai tsanani a dukan duniya. Kuma hakan ya faru da gaske a zamanin Klaudiyus.
acts/11/29: Sai almajiran suka yanke shawara a kan abin da kowannensu zai iya bayarwa, don su aika agaji ga ꞌyanꞌuwa da ke zama a Yahudiya;
acts/11/30: haka kuwa suka yi, sun ba da agajin ga dattawan ta wurin Barnabas da Shawulu. Hasiya
luke/3/1: 3 A cikin shekara ta goma sha biyar na mulkin Kaisar Tiberiyus, saꞌad da Buntus Bilatus ne gwamnan Yahudiya, Hirudus yana mulkin yankin Galili, ɗanꞌuwansa Filibus yana mulkin ƙasar Ituriya da Tarakunitas, kuma Lisaniyas ne yake mulkin yankin Abilene,
luke/3/2: a kwanakin Kayafas da babban firist Anas, sai Allah ya ba wa Yohanna ɗan Zakariya saƙo saꞌad da Yohanna yake daji.
luke/3/3: Sai Yohanna ya je dukan garuruwa da ke kewaye da Kogin Jodan, yana waꞌazi cewa mutane su yi baftisma. Hakan zai nuna cewa sun tuba don a gafarta zunubansu,
luke/3/4: kamar yadda aka rubuta a littafin annabi Ishaya cewa: “Wata murya tana kira a daji tana cewa: ‘Ku shirya hanyar Jehobah! Ku sa hanyoyinsa su miƙe.
luke/3/5: A ciccika kowane kwari, a kwantar da kowane ƙaramin tudu da kuma kowane babban tudu, a miƙe hanyar da take da kwana-kwana, a gyara mummunar hanya ta yi kyau.
luke/3/6: Kuma kowa zai ga yadda Allah zai ceci mutane.’”
luke/3/7: Sai Yohanna ya soma ce wa jamaꞌar da suke zuwa don ya yi musu baftisma: “Ku ꞌyaꞌyan macizai masu dafi, wa ya gargaɗe ku ku guje wa hukuncin nan da ke zuwa?
luke/3/8: Saboda haka, ku yi abubuwan da za su nuna cewa kun tuba. Kada ku soma gaya wa kanku cewa, ‘Ibrahim babanmu ne.’ Domin ina gaya muku cewa Allah zai iya sa duwatsun nan su zama ꞌyaꞌyan Ibrahim.
luke/3/9: Hakika, an riga an ajiye gatari a ƙarƙashin itatuwan. Saboda haka, duk wani itace da ba ya ba da ꞌyaꞌya masu kyau, za a sare shi, a jefa a cikin wuta.”
luke/3/10: Sai jamaꞌar suka yi ta tambayar sa cewa: “To mene ne ya kamata mu yi?”
luke/3/11: Sai ya amsa ya ce musu: “Bari wanda yake da riguna biyu ya ba wanda ba shi da ko ɗaya. Kuma wanda yake da abinci, shi ma ya yi haka.”
luke/3/12: Har ma masu karɓan haraji sun zo domin a yi musu baftisma, kuma suna tambayar sa cewa: “Malam, mene ne ya kamata mu yi?”
luke/3/13: Sai ya ce musu: “Kada ku karɓa fiye da harajin da aka ce ku karɓa.”
luke/3/14: Sojoji ma suna tambayar sa cewa: “Mene ne ya kamata mu yi?” Kuma ya ce musu: “Kada ku ci zarafin wani, ko ku yi ma wani zargin ƙarya, amma ku gamsu da abubuwan da kuke da su.”
luke/3/15: A lokacin, mutanen suna jiran zuwan Kristi, kuma dukansu suna tunani a zuciyarsu game da Yohanna cewa, “Anya ba shi ne Kristi ba kuwa?”
luke/3/16: Sai Yohanna ya amsa ma dukansu ya ce: “Ni dai da ruwa nake yi muku baftisma, amma wanda yake zuwa ya fi ni ƙarfi, wanda ko igiyar takalmarsa ma ban isa in kunce ba. Shi ne wanda zai yi muku baftisma da ruhu mai tsarki da kuma wuta.
luke/3/17: Matankaɗensa yana hannunsa, don ya share wurin buga hatsinsa da kyau. Kuma zai tattara alkamarsa a cikin rumbu, amma zai ƙona dusar da wutar da ba za a iya kashewa ba.”
luke/3/18: Yohanna ya kuma yi gargaɗi da yawa ga mutane kuma ya ci-gaba da yi musu shelar labari mai daɗi.
luke/3/19: Dā ma Yohanna ya tsawata wa Hirudus mai mulkin yankin, saboda Hirudiya matar ɗanꞌuwan Hirudus, da kuma dukan miyagun ayyuka da Hirudus ya aikata.
luke/3/20: Hirudus ya ƙara aikata wata mugunta kuma: Ya sa an kulle Yohanna a kurkuku.
luke/3/21: Bayan da aka yi wa dukan mutanen baftisma, Yesu ma an yi masa baftisma. Yayin da yake adduꞌa, sai sama ya buɗe.
luke/3/22: Sai ruhu mai tsarki a kamannin kurciya ya sauko a kansa, sai wata murya daga sama ta ce: “Kai Ɗana ne, wanda nake ƙauna, na amince da kai.”
luke/3/23: Saꞌad da Yesu ya soma hidimarsa, yana wajen shekara talatin, mutane sun san shi a matsayin, ɗan Yusufu, ɗan Heli,
luke/3/24: ɗan Mattat, ɗan Lawi, ɗan Malki, ɗan Jannai, ɗan Yusufu,

luke/3/28: ɗan Malki, ɗan Addi, ɗan Kosam, ɗan Elmadam, ɗan Er,
luke/3/29: ɗan Yesu, ɗan Eliyeza, ɗan Jorim, ɗan Mattat, ɗan Lawi,
luke/3/30: ɗan Simeyon, ɗan Yahuda, ɗan Yusufu, ɗan Jonam, ɗan Eliyakim,
luke/3/31: ɗan Meleya, ɗan Menna, ɗan Mattata, ɗan Natan, ɗan Dauda,

luke/3/38: ɗan Enosh, ɗan Set, ɗan Adamu, ɗan Allah. Hasiya
luke/2/1: 2 A kwanakin nan, Kaisar Augustus ya ba da umurni a yi rajistar mutanen da ke dukan duniya.
luke/2/2: (Wannan ne lokaci na farko da aka yi rajistar, kuma a lokacin, Kiriniyus ne gwamnan Siriya.)
luke/2/3: Sai dukan mutane suka koma garuruwansu, domin a yi musu rajista.
luke/2/4: Yusufu ma ya bar garin Nazaret da ke Galili, ya je garin Dauda, wato Betalami da ke Yahudiya. Tun da shi daga zuriyar Dauda ne.
luke/2/5: Ya tafi da Maryamu wadda ta riga ta zama matarsa kamar yadda aka yi masa alkawari, domin a yi musu rajista tare. A lokacin ta kusan haifuwa.
luke/2/6: Saꞌad da suke wurin, sai lokaci ya kai da za ta haifu.
luke/2/7: Sai ta haifi ɗanta na fari, ta rufe shi da zane, kuma ta kwantar da shi a wurin da ake saka wa dabbobi abinci, domin ba su samu ɗaki a wurin da baƙi suke sauka ba.
luke/2/8: A wannan yankin kuma, akwai makiyaya da ke kwana a waje suna kula da dabbobinsu da dare.
luke/2/9: Nan da nan, sai malaꞌikan Jehobah ya tsaya a gabansu, kuma ɗaukakar Jehobah ta haskaka su, sai suka ji tsoro sosai.
luke/2/10: Amma malaꞌikan ya ce musu: “Kada ku ji tsoro, domin ina yi muku shelar labari mai daɗi da zai sa dukan mutane farin ciki sosai.
luke/2/11: A yau, an haifa muku mai ceto a birnin Dauda, wanda shi ne Kristi Ubangiji.
luke/2/12: Ga alamar da za ku gani: Za ku ga jariri da aka rufe da zane kwance a inda ake saka wa dabbobi abinci.”
luke/2/13: Nan da nan, sai ga malaꞌiku da yawa, sun bayyana tare da malaꞌika na farkon, suna yabon Allah, suna cewa:
luke/2/14: “Ɗaukaka ga Allah, a can cikin sammai, a duniya kuma bari salama ta kasance da waɗanda Allah yake farin ciki da su.”
luke/2/15: Saꞌad da malaꞌikun suka koma sama, sai makiyayan suka soma ce wa juna: “Mu yi iya ƙoƙarinmu mu je Betalami don mu ga abin da ya faru da Jehobah ya bayyana mana.”
luke/2/16: Sai nan da nan suka tafi, kuma suka sami Maryamu, da Yusufu, da kuma jaririn yana kwance a wurin da ake saka wa dabbobi abinci.
luke/2/17: Da suka ga hakan, sai suka gaya wa mutane abin da aka gaya musu game da yaron.
luke/2/18: Kuma dukan mutanen da suka ji abin da makiyayan suka gaya musu, sun yi mamaki sosai.
luke/2/19: Maryamu kuwa ta riƙe duk abubuwan nan da aka faɗa a zuciyarta, tana tunanin abin da suke nufi.
luke/2/20: Sai makiyayan suka koma, suna ɗaukaka Allah, da kuma yabon sa, domin sun ji kuma sun ga abubuwa daidai yadda aka gaya musu.
luke/2/21: Da ya kai kwana takwas, kuma lokaci ya yi da za a yi masa kaciya, sai aka ba shi suna Yesu, wato sunan da malaꞌikan ya bayar kafin a ɗauki cikin sa.
luke/2/22: Ƙari ga haka, saꞌad da lokaci ya yi da za a tsarkake su bisa ga Dokar Musa, sai aka kawo shi Urushalima domin a miƙa shi ga Jehobah,
luke/2/23: kamar yadda aka rubuta a cikin Dokar Jehobah cewa: “Dole ne a keɓe duk wani ɗan fari a matsayin mai tsarki ga Jehobah.”
luke/2/24: Sai suka miƙa hadaya bisa ga abin da aka ce a cikin Dokar Jehobah, wato: “Kurciyoyi biyu ko kuma ƙananan tattabaru biyu.”
luke/2/25: Akwai wani mutum a Urushalima mai suna Simeyon, shi mutum mai adalci ne da ke bauta wa Allah da dukan zuciyarsa, yana jiran lokacin da Allah zai ceci Israꞌila, kuma ruhu mai tsarki yana tare da shi.
luke/2/26: Ƙari ga haka, Allah ya bayyana masa ta wurin ruhu mai tsarki cewa ba zai mutu ba har sai ya ga Kristi da Jehobah ya aiko.
luke/2/27: Sai ruhu mai tsarki ya sa Simeyon ya shigo cikin haikali, kuma yayin da iyayen Yesu suke kawo shi domin su yi masa abin da Doka ta ce a yi,
luke/2/28: sai ya ɗauki yaron a hannu kuma ya yabi Allah yana cewa:
luke/2/29: “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, yanzu za ka bar bawanka ya mutu cikin kwanciyar hankali kamar yadda ka faɗa,
luke/2/30: domin yanzu na ga wanda za ka yi amfani da shi ka ceci mutane,
luke/2/31: wanda ka aiko don dukan mutane su gan shi,
luke/2/32: haske ne da zai cire abin da ya rufe idanun alꞌummai kuma zai kawo ɗaukaka ga mutanenka Israꞌila.”
luke/2/33: Baban yaron da kuma mamarsa sun ci-gaba da yin mamakin abubuwan da ake faɗa game da yaron.
luke/2/34: Ƙari ga haka, Simeyon ya albarkace su kuma ya ce wa Maryamu mamar yaron: “Ga shi, an zaɓi wannan yaron domin ya zama dalilin faɗuwar waɗansu, da sake tashiwar mutane da yawa a Israꞌila, zai zama abin da mutane za su rena,
luke/2/35: domin ta haka, asirin zukatan mutane da yawa zai tonu. (Ke kuma za ki yi baƙin ciki kamar wadda aka soke ta da dogon takobi.”)
luke/2/36: Akwai wata annabiya mai suna Anna, ꞌyar Fanuwel, daga zuriyar Asher. Wannan matar tsohuwa ce, kuma ta yi shekara bakwai ne kawai da mijinta bayan da suka yi aure,
luke/2/37: sai mijinta ya mutu, yanzu shekarunta tamanin da huɗu. Tana zuwa haikali babu fasawa, kuma tana yi wa Allah hidima mai tsarki dare da rana, tana azumi da yin roƙe-roƙe sosai ga Allah.
luke/2/38: A daidai wannan lokacin, sai ta zo kusa kuma ta soma gode wa Allah, da yin magana game da yaron ga duk waɗanda suke jiran lokacin da Allah zai ceci Urushalima.
luke/2/39: Bayan da Yusufu da Maryamu suka yi dukan abubuwa da aka faɗa a Dokar Jehobah, sai suka koma garinsu Nazaret da ke Galili.
luke/2/40: Sai yaron ya ci-gaba da girma da yin ƙarfi, cike da hikima, kuma Allah ya amince da shi.
luke/2/41: Iyayensa sun saba zuwa Urushalima don Bikin Ƙetarewa a kowace shekara.
luke/2/42: Saꞌad da Yesu ya cika shekara goma sha biyu, sun je Urushalima a lokacin bikin kamar yadda suka saba.
luke/2/43: Saꞌad da aka gama bikin kuma suna dawowa, Yesu wanda yaro ne, ya tsaya a Urushalima kuma iyayensa ba su sani ba.
luke/2/44: Iyayensa sun yi tsammanin cewa yana cikin jamaꞌar da suke tafiya tare. Bayan da sun yi tafiyar yini guda, sai suka soma neman sa a tsakanin dangi da kuma abokai.
luke/2/45: Amma da ba su gan shi ba, sai suka koma Urushalima, domin su neme shi da kyau.
luke/2/46: Bayan kwana uku, sai suka gan shi a haikali, yana zaune a tsakanin malamai, yana saurararsu kuma yana yi musu tambayoyi.
luke/2/47: Amma dukan waɗanda suke saurarar sa suka yi ta mamaki game da yadda yake fahimtar abubuwa da kuma amsoshin da yake bayarwa.
luke/2/48: Saꞌad da iyayensa suka gan shi, sun yi mamaki, kuma mamarsa ta ce masa: “Ɗana, me ya sa ka yi mana haka? Ga shi ni da babanka mun damu kuma muna ta neman ka a koꞌina.”
luke/2/49: Sai ya ce musu: “Me ya sa kuke nema na? Ba ku san cewa ya kamata in kasance a gidan Ubana ba?”
luke/2/50: Amma ba su fahimci abin da yake nufi ba.
luke/2/51: Sai ya bi su, suka tafi Nazaret tare, kuma ya ci-gaba da yi musu biyayya. Ƙari ga haka, mamarsa ta ci-gaba da riƙe abubuwan nan, tana tunani a kan su a zuciyarta.
luke/2/52: Kuma Yesu ya ci-gaba da samun ƙarin hikima, da yin girma. Yana kuma samun farin jini a gaban Allah da kuma mutane. Hasiya
